minor.finding: "Highlights" (supplement block) is rendered 要点 across the eight new supplement keys (status.preparing/cancelled/failed, explanation.model_unavailable/service_unresponsive/cost_limit/time_limit/retryable), but existing zh-CN copy renders the same product term as 重点文件 (ui.canvas.files.highlights, ui.canvas.finder_layout.highlights, ui.notices.files.highlights_update_failed); 要点 also suggests textual key points while the block holds graphics and pinned files. Meaning is understandable, so not gating. Suggestion: one 重点 family for all eight keys, e.g. 正在准备重点内容…… / 重点内容已取消 / 无法准备重点内容 / 生成重点内容的模型当前不可用。…; disposition: fix in the next remediation wave if one runs, otherwise deferred as a glossary follow-up.

"解除该团队" leaves 解除 without its usual object (关联/绑定), so it can read as "dismiss/disband the team" rather than "detach the session from the team"; existing zh-CN uses 解除关联 for unlinking (ui.projects.project_links.unlink_title). The literal command makes the action unambiguous, so not gating. Suggestion: "请先运行{detachCommand}，解除此会话与该团队的关联。" (or shorter "…解除团队关联。" for the narrow popover); disposition: fix in the next remediation wave if one runs, otherwise deferred.
